title: Bell violation without signalling may follow from the framework

statements.text: Some basic quantum phenomena, the violation of Bell inequalities together with no-signalling, might be understood as consequences of the framework once it admits forgetting. This is sketched, not derived.

sources.quote: some basic phenomena of quantum theory (Bell inequality violation and no-signalling) might be understood as consequences of this framework
has been sketched in [2], but it needs further elaboration
